subject: lean ninja in a black shinobi outfit with a red sash and mask, katana in the right hand
motion: throwing three shuriken in a fan
facing: in a three-quarter view facing screen-right
effects: three spinning shuriken with thin silver motion trails

plan.source: Ninja stands three-quarter facing right, wide stance with right foot forward; right hand holds a low, forward katana; left hand grips the scabbard at the hip; torso slightly crouched, head looking right.

frames.pose: Anticipation: torso leans back onto rear left leg; head dips. Right hand draws katana slightly in toward hip, tip still low-right. Left hand releases scabbard, pulls back by left ear clutching three shuriken. Right foot light, left foot planted wide.

Key: torso snaps forward over right leg, hips turn right; head aims right. Left arm whips across and forward, releasing three shuriken in a fan. Right arm extends, katana low as counterbalance. Right foot planted, left heel pivots.
frames.effect: Three spinning shuriken just past left hand—high at head, mid at chest, low at thigh—fanning right; thin silver trails arcing from left shoulder to each; short arc trail along left forearm path.

frames.pose: Follow-through: torso carried forward then down; head tracks right. Left arm continues across and down, open palm near right hip. Right arm brings katana forward to guard mid. Right foot firm, left toe pivoting.
frames.effect: Shuriken farther right along the three arcs; trails thinner and shorter behind each.

frames.pose: Settle: torso rises toward neutral, weight recenters. Left hand returns to grip scabbard at hip. Right hand lowers katana toward its original low-forward line. Both feet reset—right forward, left back; head steady right.
